column3: Installed CodeWarrior MSL msl_utility:859 defines compressed_pair::second as return base::second(). Restoring MSL's empty vector -> __vector_imp -> __vector_pod constructor layer makes valueOfHiring emit this wrapper at candidate +0x428/+0x440/+0x454 for capacity_ access. Retail calls the corresponding details::compressed_pair_imp::second at +0x400/+0x418/+0x42c. Both receive the same pair address in r3 and return its second-member reference; the emitted wrapper's full four-byte body is blr, identical to the independently bounded pinned 0:0x215c accessor before the next prologue at 0x2160. This is a verified library-template ABI alias, not a source-owned game helper.
